answer: An attester must stake 24% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. Because the vertex stake is held until the prism settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the basalt audit lists each exposure. A farm running 179 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
